correctness.rationale: The exact Fock Gram matrix on an area-preserving ellipse is a real-analytic trace-class perturbation. Disk eigenvalues provide an isolated simple top eigenvalue. Exact angular integrals give Pprime_20(0)=s²exp(-s)/sqrt(2), Psecond_00(0)=-2s²exp(-s), and zero other first couplings. The full Kato second derivative and quarter-turn evenness establish the t² coefficient with O_s(t⁴) remainder; eigenvector perturbation gives h2 response with O_s(t²). Independent direct quadrature checker passed 148 assertions. No finite checks are substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: The quantitatively sharp cost of area-preserving anisotropy for the optimally selected Gaussian-STFT signal addresses a specifically highlighted missing low-eccentricity ellipse eigenfunction. It distinguishes fixed-signal trial loss s²exp(-s) from the exact optimized loss 2s²exp(-s)/(s+2), identifies the precise first signal correction, and gives the natural peak-sensitivity area. It is local and one-parametric but yields an exact motivated spectral stability benchmark.
